# telnyx_ai_assistant_tests (Data Source)

Lists ai assistant tests, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_ai_assistant_test`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `destination` (String) Filter tests by destination (phone number, webhook URL, etc.)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `telnyx_conversation_channel` (String) Filter tests by communication channel (e.g., 'web_chat', 'sms')
- `test_suite` (String) Filter tests by test suite name

### Read-Only

- `ai_assistant_tests` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ai_assistant_tests))

<a id="nestedatt--ai_assistant_tests"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ai_assistant_tests`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the test was created.
- `description` (String) Detailed description of the test's purpose and scope.
- `destination` (String) Target destination for test conversations.
- `instructions` (String) Detailed test scenario instructions and objectives.
- `max_duration_seconds` (Number) Maximum allowed duration for test execution in seconds.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the test.
- `rubric` (Attributes List) Evaluation criteria used to assess test performance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ai_assistant_tests--rubric))
- `telnyx_conversation_channel` (String) Communication channel used for test execution.
- `test_id` (String) Unique identifier for the assistant test.
- `test_suite` (String) Test suite grouping for organizational purposes.

<a id="nestedatt--ai_assistant_tests--rubric"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ai_assistant_tests.rubric`

Read-Only:

- `criteria` (String) Specific guidance on how to assess the assistant’s performance for this rubric item.
- `name` (String) Label for the evaluation criterion, e.g., Empathy, Accuracy, Clarity.
